claims: University of Southern California (USC) is a private research university in Los Angeles.
USC has a 9.81%–10.4% acceptance rate as of 2024–2025.
USC is ranked #28 in National Universities.
Annenberg Media reports around 83,500 applicants for USC fall 2025.
Annenberg Media reports an acceptance rate of approximately 10.4% for USC fall 2025.
Admitted USC students generally have GPAs of 3.86+.
U.S. News & World Report ranks USC at #28 in National Universities.
PrepScholar lists popular fields at USC as Business/Management, Communications, Social Sciences, Visual and Performing Arts, and Engineering.
USC is the oldest private research university in California.
PrepScholar states a GPA of 3.86 or higher is typically expected for USC admission.
USC admission requires a completed Common Application.
USC admission requires letters of recommendation.
There is a Facebook for the University of South Carolina.
